Animate this exact three-scientist image in one four-second shot, locked camera. The silver-haired man at LEFT playfully mimes a mean monster to his colleagues: he hunches forward, lowers his eyebrows and makes a restrained mock snarl, curling ONLY HIS ONE BRASS HAND into a claw near his face. One small prowling shoulder movement completes his demonstration. His colleagues grow visibly worried: the bespectacled man draws back slightly and gives the brunette woman an uneasy glance; she frowns and presses her lips together, looking from the pitch to her colleague. Neither smiles.
CRITICAL CHARACTER CONTINUITY: the silver-haired scientist has exactly ONE metal hand, his anatomical RIGHT hand visible on SCREEN LEFT, attached to the brass forearm. His other anatomical LEFT hand, visible nearer the CENTER scientist, is normal peach-colored human SKIN with five bare flesh fingers. At the beginning he lowers that flesh hand to rest flat on the table and LEAVES IT FLAT AND STILL there throughout the rest of the shot. That hand NEVER becomes metallic, gloved, clawed or brass. ONLY the already-metal hand does the monster claw gesture. Keep the left sleeve and skin wrist fully recognizable, not gold in color. Do not raise both hands. No transformation. Keep all three human faces and clothing unchanged.
0-0.5s settle flesh hand onto plans. 0.5-1.5s lean and hunch, brass fingers curl near face. 1.5-3.3s mock-menacing expression with one subtle shoulder prowl, colleagues exchange worried looks. 3.3-4s maintain living motion. Modest natural mouth movement, no exact lip-sync. No extra people or monsters.
Preserve rich illustrated ink contours, crosshatching, restrained halftone, warm amber practical lighting and dark teal atmosphere. Maintain reference character identities and coherent anatomy. No photorealism, glossy CGI, captions, speech bubbles, cuts or generated audio.
